claims.text: Take with plenty of fluid to reduce esophageal irritation and ulceration.
claims.quote: Administration of adequate amounts of fluid along with capsule and tablet forms of drugs in the tetracycline class is recommended to wash down the drugs and reduce the risk of esophageal irritation and ulceration.

claims.text: Photosensitivity: warn patients exposed to sun or UV light; stop at the first skin erythema.
claims.quote: Patients apt to be exposed to direct sunlight or ultraviolet light should be advised that this reaction can occur with tetracycline drugs, and treatment should be discontinued at the first evidence of skin erythema.
